svg.title: Locus relations
svg.desc: A unified set of thirty-two relation entries. Equivalent forms share one entry. Each entry includes a diagram and a description.

g.aria-label: expr == expr: Equal numeric measurements; length(s) == length(t) expresses segment congruence.
a < b / a > b / a <= b / a >= b: Compare numeric measurements with matching dimensions, strictly or inclusively.
g.text: a < b / a > b / a <= b / a >= b

g.aria-label: center(A, B): Align both measured centers; two points coincide. Sizing stays independent.
g.text: Align both measured centers; two points

g.aria-label: align_center_x(A, B): Shared horizontal center; points share an x position. No ordering or separation.
g.text: Shared horizontal center; points share an x

g.aria-label: align_center_y(A, B): Shared vertical center; points share a y position. No ordering or separation.
g.text: Shared vertical center; points share a y

g.aria-label: align_left(A, B): Align left bounds; other placement stays free.
g.text: Align left bounds; other placement stays

g.aria-label: align_right(A, B): Align right bounds; other placement stays free.
g.text: Align right bounds; other placement stays

g.aria-label: align_top(A, B): Align top bounds; other placement stays free.
g.text: Align top bounds; other placement stays free.

g.aria-label: align_bottom(A, B): Align bottom bounds; other placement stays free.
g.text: Align bottom bounds; other placement stays

g.aria-label: gap_x(A, B): Left-to-right bounds separation with an automatic gap; no alignment.
gap_y(A, B, C): Top-to-bottom bounds separation with automatic gaps; no alignment.
row(A, B, C): Left-to-right order with shared vertical center.
column(A, B, C): Top-to-bottom order with shared horizontal center.
inset_left(A, B): Inner left margin, or shared border with padding: none; y stays free.
g.text: Inner left margin, or shared border with

g.aria-label: inset_right(A, B): Inner right margin, or shared border with padding: none; y stays free.
g.text: Inner right margin, or shared border with

g.aria-label: inset_top(A, B): Inner top margin, or shared border with padding: none; x stays free.
g.text: Inner top margin, or shared border with

g.aria-label: inset_bottom(A, B): Inner bottom margin, or shared border with padding: none; x stays free.
g.text: Inner bottom margin, or shared border with

g.aria-label: cover_x(A, B, C): A covers their horizontal extent; height and y stay free.
g.text: A covers their horizontal extent; height and

g.aria-label: cover_y(A, B, C): A covers their vertical extent; width and x stay free.
g.text: A covers their vertical extent; width and x

g.aria-label: contain(B, A): Enclose all of A’s measured bounds in B’s actual interior, with style padding.
g.text: Enclose all of A’s measured bounds in B’s

g.aria-label: inside(P, obj): P is strictly inside a circle, ellipse, or simple polygon; boundary points are excluded.
g.text: P is strictly inside a circle, ellipse, or
simple polygon; boundary points are excluded.

g.aria-label: on(P, obj): P lies on supported geometry; closed endpoints count. Ellipses are supported.
g.text: P lies on supported geometry; closed

g.aria-label: avoid(path, obstacle): Keep listed geometry clear with automatic clearance.
g.text: Keep listed geometry clear with automatic

g.aria-label: trim_endpoints(path, B): Clip interior path ends to B; retain original points.
g.text: Clip interior path ends to B; retain original

g.aria-label: tangent(c, obj): Circle touches a linear object or another circle externally; closed endpoint contact counts.
g.text: Circle touches a linear object or another

g.aria-label: internally_tangent(outer, inner): Inner circle touches outer internally; outer radius must be strictly larger.
g.text: Inner circle touches outer internally; outer

g.aria-label: parallel(l1, l2): Linear objects have parallel directions; both directions must be nonzero.
g.text: Linear objects have parallel directions; both

g.aria-label: perpendicular(l1, l2): Linear objects meet at a right angle; both directions must be nonzero.
g.text: Linear objects meet at a right angle; both

g.aria-label: collinear(A, B, C, ...): All points share the line through distinct A and B; their order is unrestricted.
g.text: All points share the line through distinct A
and B; their order is unrestricted.

g.aria-label: concyclic(A, B, C, D, ...): All points share the circumcircle of three distinct, non-collinear initial points.
g.text: All points share the circumcircle of three

g.aria-label: midpoint(M, A, B): M is halfway between A and B; A–M and M–B have equal lengths.
g.text: M is halfway between A and B; A–M and M–B

g.aria-label: between(A, B, C): B lies strictly between distinct A and C on their line; endpoints are excluded.
g.text: B lies strictly between distinct A and C on
Combine conditions with and, or, and not. Insets accept padding: none for shared borders.
